stories.h: Rare tornado warning hits Eastside after Renton landspout
stories.s: On Thanksgiving, spotters reported a landspout near Renton heading east, which prompted a brief NWS tornado warning for Issaquah, Snoqualmie and North Bend. The warning expired at 12:15 p.m., and no damage was reported.

stories.h: Metro reroutes downtown buses for tree lighting Friday
stories.s: Metro buses run weekday schedules Friday, while Link runs a Saturday schedule and Sounder is off. Several downtown routes detour for the Westlake tree lighting, and Sunday's Seattle Marathon brings wide morning reroutes.

stories.h: Juveniles trade gunfire in Seattle's Yesler Terrace
stories.s: Seattle police say two groups of juveniles exchanged shots near E. Yesler Way on Thanksgiving afternoon, and witnesses reported up to 20 rounds. An 18-year-old found with a stolen gun was arrested but was not tied to the shooting.

stories.h: King County wastewater shows world-high meth levels
stories.s: An EU drug agency study of sewage from 115 cities found the highest methamphetamine levels in samples from King County's West Point and Renton plants. Researchers say the data can't show how many people use the drug.

stories.h: Renton man shot multiple times in neighbor feud
stories.s: A Renton man is at Harborview after a neighbor shot him several times during a Monday-evening dispute. Police arrested and booked the suspect and say the two had a long-running feud.

coming.h: Westlake Park tree lighting and fireworks
coming.s: Free celebration from 11 a.m. to 6 p.m. Friday, with the tree and star lit at 5 p.m. and fireworks after. Expect downtown bus detours.

coming.h: Bellevue's Snowflake Lane begins nightly run
coming.s: The free 20–25 minute show on Bellevue Way between NE 4th and NE 8th starts nightly at 7 p.m. from Nov. 27 through Dec. 24.

coming.h: Seattle Marathon reroutes dozens of bus routes
coming.s: Many Metro and ST routes, including RapidRide C, D and G, detour Sunday morning, some until 3 p.m., for the Seattle Marathon.

coming.h: Holiday in the Park at Volunteer Park
coming.s: A free holiday event at Seattle's Volunteer Park, 5 to 7:30 p.m.
